title: The worked package's first draft reads a field its input's schema does not declare: check reports it as an error, so the draft does not conform, and pack reports the same finding and writes nothing
notes: Appendix B's first draft: package/ is gen/worked-package's package with one difference, templates/announcement.txt.liquid reading inputs.release.data where the schema declares date. The check finds it with no data at all, and names date as the nearest declared name.
